A_ServiceDistribution: Existing 120/208V 1PH 200A service and existing Panels A (200A MLO) and B (100A MLO) to remain; field verify circuits and conditions.
Existing feeder 2"C (4)3/0 CU #6 GND and Panel B feed from A27,29 to remain; verify, label, and update panel directories.
Coordinate with the utility on the existing service; a service upgrade is not included pending RFI on the Panel A 191A calculated load.
B_BranchPower: Provide 40A/2P connections to COMP #1/#2 and AHU #1/#2 with disconnects, WP GFI receptacles at condensers, and 3/4" empty HVAC control conduit.
Provide branch circuits per Panel A schedule; upsize to #10 over 75 ft and #8 over 130 ft; copper THHN/THWN; minimum 1" conduit.
Remove existing fixtures, devices, and disconnects per the demolition plans; make safe; install mechanical-furnished starters and 120V duct smoke detector circuits.
C_LightingControls: Complete lighting package (ECFECI) — procured through the Southern Lighting Source national account (770-242-4000). EC to receive, inventory, and install all fixtures per schedule.
Install single-pole and 3-way switching, Hubbell occupancy sensors, and a Leviton VP24 astronomic timer; EM/exit on line side; test and commission all controls.
Fixture types A, B, C (existing), D, E1, E2, E3 and G per the E3.0 schedule; Type H is pending RFI.
D_SiteLightingUnderground: No site lighting or underground allowances shown on the drawings.
Exterior below-grade conduit to be Schedule 40 PVC where required for condenser circuits; WP lift covers on all exterior devices.
E_LowVoltage: Telephone outlet box with conduit stub in Office #2; cabling, devices, and terminations by the low-voltage vendor.
F_Coordination: Electrical permit, inspections, and coordination with GC, mechanical, and utility; firestop penetrations at the existing 2-hour rated wall.
Coordinate starter and duct smoke detector locations with the mechanical contractor; verify new versus existing receptacles in the field.
Closeout: as-built drawings, typed panel directories, and final testing of emergency and exit lighting and controls.
